name: Escape Waves For Lucky Blocks
desc:
Welcome to Escape Waves For Lucky Blocks!

Move fast and secure Lucky Blocks across the map! 🏃
Survive powerful waves as they roll in! 🌊
Build your Brainrot setup over time and stay alive as long as possible! ⚡
Upgrade your plot to unlock more plots and place additional Brainrots! 🏗️

Your Brainrots earn cash OFFLINE! 💤

Like the game and join the group for FREE cash and a Brainrot! 👍
